# 15 Minute Plan

> AI-powered SBA-approved business plan generator that creates professional business plans in 15 minutes.

15 Minute Plan leverages artificial intelligence to streamline business planning for entrepreneurs seeking rapid plan creation for funding, loans, or investor pitches. The platform combines an interactive form wizard with example templates and editing features to deliver comprehensive business plans quickly.

## Key Topics

- AI business plan generator
- SBA-approved plans
- Quick plan creation
- Investor funding
- Bank loan applications
- Business plan template
- Entrepreneur tool
- Plan editing features
- Form wizard
- Objective selection
- Business status assessment
- Funding purpose identification
- Example plans
- Step-by-step onboarding

## Core Product

- [AI Business Plan Generator](https://www.15minuteplan.ai): Main landing page for the AI-powered business plan generator creating SBA-approved plans in 15 minutes
- [Plan Generator Wizard](https://www.15minuteplan.ai/form/objective): Interactive form wizard for creating business plans with objective selection and step-by-step guidance
